span.p:
Architectural risk:
correctness depends on unblock protocol
and dependency publication discipline.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ready-state risk:
payload lives outside scheduler,
so readers rely on publication
happening before this transition
becomes observable.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Recovery path exists,
but repeated retries can hide
ownership / publication design issues.
